newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai residents buy half commercial housing.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai residents buy half commercial housing.

text.p: Private citizens have bought a total of 1.21 million square metres of commercial housing or 55 percent of the city's housing space sold in the first nine months of 1996, the Business News said on Wednesday.
In the past, companies and work-units were the biggest buyers of commercial housing.
In the period, Shanghai sold 2.22 million square metres of commercial housing, of which 93.6 percent was apartments, and completed 4.34 million square metres, the newspaper said.
As of the end of September, 44.67 million square metres of commercial housing were under construction, including 31.06 million square metres of apartments, it said.
Shanghai's 3,138 property firms, including 402 foreign ones had invested 30.2 billion yuan in property in the first nine months of the year, it said but gave no further details.
